In 7 days, Sofie will walk twice as far as Brian. Since Sofie walks 10 miles every day, in 7 days she will walk:

$$
10 \, \text{miles/day} \times 7 \, \text{days} = 70 \, \text{miles}
$$

If this distance is twice the distance Brian walks in 7 days, then Brian walks:

$$
\frac{70 \, \text{miles}}{2} = 35 \, \text{miles}
$$

FINAL_ANSWER: 35
